description_en: Retrieves global security event statistics, including the number of unfixed vulnerabilities, baseline checks, and alerts
description_zh: 获取全局安全事件统计数据，包括未修复的漏洞数量、基线检查数量和告警数量等
name: DescribeAllRegionsStatistics

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The source of the data request. Default value: aqs. Valid values:
sas: The data request comes from Security Center.
aqs: The data request comes from Server Guard
parameters.help_zh:
数据的请求来源。默认aqs。取值：
sas：表示数据请求来源为云安全中心
aqs：表示数据请求来源为安骑士
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The asset name or public IP address
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the member accounts in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Account.description_en: The number of asset logon events

Health.description_en: The total number of unfixed baseline checks
Health.description_zh: 未修复的基线检查总数

NewSuspicious.description_en:
The number of Server Guard or Security Center alerts.

If From is set to sas, this value indicates the number of Security Center alerts.
If From is set to aqs, this value indicates the number of Server Guard alerts
NewSuspicious.description_zh:
安骑士或云安全中心告警数量。

若From为 sas：该数据表示云安全中心告警数量
若From为 aqs：表示安骑士告警数量

Suspicious.description_en: The number of Server Guard security alerts
Suspicious.description_zh: 安骑士安全告警的数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
